pages.title: Fruit From Stone
pages.text: A pecked fruit can start your own exotic orchard.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Retrieve petrified fruit from cassowary nests and offer it to the bird. Kiwano grows at ground level; litchi and starfruit form small trees, each with growth stages. One chosen fruit is enough.

pages.title: Practical note
